name: focus
title: Word Focus Effect
blurb: Words blur and sharpen in sequence with an animated corner-bracket highlight.
description: Splits text into words and cycles focus with a glowing corner-bracket element animating to each. Focused word is sharp, others blur. Can cycle automatically or respond to hover.
use_when: A heading wants to emphasize words sequentially with visual hierarchy and sci-fi aesthetic.
avoid_when: When all words need simultaneous readability.
a11y: All words remain in DOM; blur is visual only. Readable in any order.
